== Date of the event ==

[[Alex Alcalde]]'s director's report says the regional "was held this Saturday". Decipher's NewsFlash copy is dated Monday 27 September 1999, which would put the event on 25 September 1999. But [[Thomas McManus]] and [[Steven Horton]] both date their reports of the Danger Room tournament in Anderson, Indiana, 9-25-99, and Horton, who lost to [[Chad McCory]] there, calls him "the Corellia regional winner". Both cannot be right if the regional was on 25 September. The article gives September 1999 until a Decipher calendar or another dated source settles it.

Sources: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618013958/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html regional.html] (Internet Archive), [https://web.archive.org/web/20000226090748/http://decipher.com:80/newsflash/1999/0999/092799storyA.html NewsFlash 27 September 1999] (Internet Archive), [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030128/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Horton's report] (Internet Archive).
